description: Rate a measurement system from a crossed study: every operator measures every part, the same number of times. Two-way ANOVA per the AIAG Measurement Systems Analysis manual (4th ed.), matching Minitab's crossed gage R&R defaults: the operator × part interaction is pooled into repeatability when not significant (α = 0.05). Reports %GRR of study variation and, when a tolerance is given, of the tolerance, the repeatability / reproducibility split, the number of distinct categories, and the AIAG band (under 10% acceptable, 10–30% conditional, over 30% unacceptable). The standard study is 10 parts, 3 operators, 2–3 trials. Run it before trusting a Cpk.

name.description: Operator label, e.g. "A". For your own bookkeeping; the calculation and the readout identify operators by position.

trials.description: One array per trial, each listing this operator's readings for parts 1…N in the same part order, in the dimension's own units

study_code.description: A study as the Lab card encodes it; use instead of the measurements (operators, tolerance)

tolerance.description: Tolerance width (upper limit minus lower limit), same units as the readings. Enables %GRR of tolerance, which is what a Cpk study needs.

name: gage_rr
title: Gage R&R (crossed, ANOVA method)
